description.pt: Homebrew nativos, emuladores, clientes de streaming e utilitários para Nintendo Switch 2.
description.en: Native homebrew, emulators, streaming clients, and utilities for Nintendo Switch 2.

description.pt: Recompilações nativas multiplataforma da série Heroes Lore (Windows, Linux, Android, Switch e Switch 2).
description.en: Multiplatform native recompilations of the Heroes Lore series (Windows, Linux, Android, Switch & Switch 2).

description.pt: Aplicativos multiplataforma, sites oficiais e pacotes desenvolvidos com Flutter para Android, Windows, VR e Web.
description.en: Cross-platform apps, official sites, and packages built with Flutter for Android, Windows, VR, and Web.

projects.title: PPSSPP-nx2

summary.pt: Port nativo do emulador de PSP (PPSSPP-nx) para Nintendo Switch 2 construído com ounce-devkit (libounce), OunceVK (Vulkan 1.4 nativo + Zink OpenGL) e ARM64 JIT via kaiHEN.
summary.en: Native Nintendo Switch 2 port of the PSP emulator (PPSSPP-nx) built with ounce-devkit (libounce), OunceVK (native Vulkan 1.4 + Zink OpenGL), and kaiHEN ARM64 JIT.

body.pt: Copie PPSSPP-switch2.nro para o cartão SD e execute via Homebrew Menu em modo full-RAM (Title Override) no Switch 2 com kaiHEN.
body.en: Copy PPSSPP-switch2.nro to your SD card and launch via Homebrew Menu in full-RAM mode (title override) on Switch 2 with kaiHEN.

projects.releaseNotes: Native Switch 2 port of PPSSPP-nx with OunceVK (Vulkan 1.4 + Zink OpenGL), shared 32 MiB kaiHEN JIT pool for Arm64IRJit and VertexDecoderJitCache, and complete kaihenJitPublishRanges coverage.

projects.title: Vita3K-nx2

summary.pt: Port nativo do emulador de PlayStation Vita (Vita3K-nx) para Nintendo Switch 2 com Vulkan 1.4 via OunceVK, ARM64 JIT (Dynarmic via kaiHEN), launcher gráfico completo e suporte a LSFG 2x.
summary.en: Native Nintendo Switch 2 port of the PlayStation Vita emulator (Vita3K-nx) featuring Vulkan 1.4 via OunceVK, ARM64 JIT (Dynarmic via kaiHEN), full graphical launcher, and LSFG 2x support.

body.pt: Copie Vita3K-switch2.nro para sdmc:/switch/vita3k/ e execute via Homebrew Menu em modo full-RAM (Title Override) no Switch 2 com kaiHEN.
body.en: Copy Vita3K-switch2.nro to sdmc:/switch/vita3k/ and launch via Homebrew Menu in full-RAM mode (title override) on Switch 2 with kaiHEN.

projects.releaseNotes: Full Graphical Switch Launcher with bundled core emulator (Vita3K-switch2.nro), Native Vulkan 1.4 (OunceVK) + ARM64 JIT (Dynarmic via kaiHEN), verified commercial PS Vita gameplay, LSFG 2x Frame Generation (Vulkan), and Switch 2 auto-updater.

projects.title: GMCA NX2

summary.pt: Port nativo do Gamepad Media Center Aggregator para Nintendo Switch 2 e Switch 1. Reúne Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Stremio e servidores WebDAV/FTP/SFTP/HTTP em uma interface otimizada para controle.
summary.en: Native port of Gamepad Media Center Aggregator for Nintendo Switch 2 & Switch 1. Connects to Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Stremio, and WebDAV/FTP/SFTP/HTTP servers in a single controller-first .nro.

body.pt: Inclui builds separadas para Switch 2 (GMCA-switch2.nro via libounce/OunceVK) e Switch 1 (GMCA-switch1.nro), com atualizador integrado.
body.en: Includes separate builds for Switch 2 (GMCA-switch2.nro via libounce/OunceVK) and Switch 1 (GMCA-switch1.nro), with built-in auto-updater.

projects.releaseNotes: Compiled for Switch 2 using ounce-devkit, EGL + GLES 3.2 via Mesa Zink/NVK Vulkan, FFmpeg 7.1 + libmpv 0.39.0. Hardware-verified on real Nintendo Switch 2 with Stremio login, addon sync, and playback.

projects.title: Super Moonlight NX2

summary.pt: Cliente Moonlight para Nintendo Switch 2 com VPN Tailscale embutida em userspace (Rust + WireGuard). Faça streaming de jogos do PC via Sunshine em rede local ou de qualquer lugar do mundo sem sysmodules.
summary.en: Moonlight client for Nintendo Switch 2 with built-in userspace Tailscale VPN (Rust + WireGuard). Stream PC games from Sunshine over LAN or anywhere in the world inside a single .nro.

body.pt: Ative em Settings → Tailscale e escaneie o QR Code exibido na tela do Switch 2 para conectar e importar seus PCs do Tailnet com um clique.
body.en: Enable under Settings → Tailscale and scan the on-screen QR Code on Switch 2 to sign in and import online Tailnet PCs with one click.

projects.releaseNotes: Embedded userspace Tailscale VPN (tsnx-core + rustls + WireGuard + smoltcp), in-app Tailscale settings panel, on-screen QR code login, one-click Import Tailnet PCs, and 120 Hz / 4K hardware AV1/H.264 decoding.

projects.title: BattleShip-Remix NS2

summary.pt: Port nativo do BattleShip-Remix (Super Smash Bros. 64 + mod Smash Remix 2.0.1) para Nintendo Switch 2 usando libounce e OunceVK (OpenGL 3.3 Core Profile sobre Vulkan/Zink), validado em hardware real.
summary.en: Native Nintendo Switch 2 port of BattleShip-Remix (Super Smash Bros. 64 + Smash Remix 2.0.1) built with libounce and OunceVK (OpenGL 3.3 Core Profile over Vulkan/Zink), verified on real hardware.

body.pt: Requer os arquivos de assets extraídos da sua própria cópia/ROM do jogo na pasta /switch/BattleShip-Remix no cartão SD.
body.en: Requires extracted game assets from your own legally owned ROM placed in /switch/BattleShip-Remix on your SD card.

projects.releaseNotes: Native Switch 2 ABI (OUN0 / Cortex-A78C), OpenGL 3.3 Core Profile via OunceVK, safe hardware hooks without Switch 1 CPU overclock calls, and auto-discovery of /switch/BattleShip-Remix.

projects.title: StremNX2

summary.pt: Cliente não oficial do Stremio para Nintendo Switch 2 e Switch 1 com interface estilo streaming, sincronização de conta e addons, player mpv/FFmpeg 7.1, motor torrent integrado e downloads no cartão SD.
summary.en: Unofficial Stremio client for Nintendo Switch 2 & Switch 1 with streaming-style UI, account & addon sync, mpv/FFmpeg 7.1 player, built-in torrent engine, and SD card downloads.

body.pt: Copie stremnx-switch2.nro para sdmc:/switch/stremnx/stremnx.nro e abra pelo Homebrew Menu em Title Mode (segurando R ao iniciar um jogo).
body.en: Copy stremnx-switch2.nro to sdmc:/switch/stremnx/stremnx.nro and launch from Homebrew Menu in Title Mode (hold R while starting a game).

projects.releaseNotes: Native ARMv8 Cortex-A78C Switch 2 build (libounce + OunceVK), clean FFmpeg 7.1 with multi-threaded decoding, stable EGL/GLES context switching between SDL UI and libmpv, and built-in updater.

projects.title: Switch2IPTV

summary.pt: Player de IPTV homebrew em português para Nintendo Switch 2 e Switch 1. Suporta Xtream Codes e playlists M3U, abas de Ao Vivo/Filmes/Séries, EPG, busca global, favoritos e retomada de reprodução.
summary.en: Homebrew IPTV player in Portuguese for Nintendo Switch 2 & Switch 1. Supports Xtream Codes and M3U playlists, Live/Movies/Series tabs, EPG, global search, favorites, and resume playback.

body.pt: Favoritos, histórico e credenciais ficam armazenados somente no cartão SD — nenhum dado é enviado para servidores externos.
body.en: Favorites, watch history, and credentials are stored locally on your SD card only.

projects.releaseNotes: Native Switch 2 port using libounce + OunceVK (EGL + OpenGL ES 3.0) with libmpv and clean FFmpeg 7.1 for cortex-a78c, plus Switch 1 build included.

projects.title: Switch2NOW

summary.pt: Cliente homebrew nativo do GeForce NOW para Nintendo Switch 2 e Switch 1 com interface Borealis, WebRTC nativo, decodificação H.264 por hardware, áudio Opus e localização em Português (Brasil).
summary.en: Native GeForce NOW homebrew client for Nintendo Switch 2 & Switch 1 featuring Borealis UI, native WebRTC signaling, hardware H.264 decoding, Opus audio, and Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) localization.

body.pt: Requer conta válida do GeForce NOW. Compatível com kaiHEN / ounce-hbmenu no Switch 2 e Atmosphère / hbmenu no Switch 1.
body.en: Requires a valid GeForce NOW account. Compatible with kaiHEN / ounce-hbmenu on Switch 2 and Atmosphère / hbmenu on Switch 1.

projects.releaseNotes: Native Switch 2 port with ounce-devkit / OunceVK, hardware H.264 decoding via viddec with FFmpeg fallback, libopus + audout audio, and pt-BR localization.

projects.title: green-nx (Switch 2)

summary.pt: Cliente open-source de Xbox Cloud Gaming (xCloud) para Nintendo Switch 2 e Switch 1. Streaming nativo via WebRTC em 720p/1080p HQ com decodificação H.264 por hardware e renderização GPU zero-copy.
summary.en: Open-source Xbox Cloud Gaming (xCloud) client for Nintendo Switch 2 & Switch 1. Standalone WebRTC streaming at 720p/1080p HQ with hardware H.264 decoding and zero-copy GPU rendering.

body.pt: Faça login com sua conta Microsoft (device-code) diretamente no console — não requer PC nem aplicativo auxiliar.
body.en: Sign in with your Microsoft account via device-code directly on the console — no companion app or PC required.

projects.releaseNotes: Nintendo Switch 2 port built with ounce-devkit / libounce / OunceVK OpenGL ES and hardware H.264 decoder (GSV1/viddec), compatible with ounce-hbmenu and kaiHEN.

projects.title: NS2ToolKit

summary.pt: Assistente portátil para Windows que facilita executar o ns2jb no SmileBASIC, ativar homebrew (kaiHEN), fazer backup/restauração de saves e jogos do Nintendo Switch 2 e gerar pacotes NUP no PC.
summary.en: Portable Windows assistant to run ns2jb on SmileBASIC, activate Switch 2 homebrew (kaiHEN), back up/restore Nintendo Switch 2 saves and games, and generate NUP packages on PC.

body.pt: Inclui Node, Python e todas as DLLs necessárias. Extraia o ZIP em uma pasta nova no Windows 10/11 x64 e execute Abrir NS2.cmd.
body.en: Bundles Node, Python, and all required DLLs. Extract the ZIP to a writable folder on Windows 10/11 x64 and run Abrir NS2.cmd.

projects.releaseNotes: Ativação de homebrew pela mesma conexão 4/4 mantida aberta, etapas guiadas para kaiHEN + hbmenu, backup/restauração de saves com pré-backup automático e validação em console real.

projects.title: Heroes Lore: Wind of Soltia

summary.pt: Recompilação nativa em C++17 + SDL2 do clássico RPG J2ME Heroes Lore: Wind of Soltia. Executa o bytecode original decompilado com fidelidade determinística em Windows, Linux, Android, Switch e Switch 2.
summary.en: Native C++17 + SDL2 recompilation of the classic J2ME RPG Heroes Lore: Wind of Soltia. Executes decompiled original bytecode deterministically on Windows, Linux, Android, Switch 1, and Switch 2.

body.pt: 100% jogável com saves funcionando e suporte aos idiomas PT-BR, EN, IT e ES. Builds prontas para Android, Windows, Linux, Switch 1 e Switch 2.
body.en: 100% playable with working saves and PT-BR, EN, IT & ES language support. Ready-to-run builds for Android, Windows, Linux, Switch 1, and Switch 2.

projects.releaseNotes: Adicionado heroes_lore_switch2.nro compilado com ounce-devkit para kaiHEN/ounce-hbmenu (testado em console real), preservando os binários de Windows, Linux, Android e Switch 1.

projects.title: Heroes Lore 2: Knight of Frozen Sea

summary.pt: Recompilação nativa multiplataforma de Heroes Lore 2: The Knight of Frozen Sea com builds disponíveis para Android, Windows, Linux, Nintendo Switch 1 e Nintendo Switch 2.
summary.en: Multiplatform native recompilation of Heroes Lore 2: The Knight of Frozen Sea with builds available for Android, Windows, Linux, Nintendo Switch 1, and Nintendo Switch 2.

body.pt: Inclui build dedicada heroes_lore_2_switch2.nro com recursos no RomFS, validada em hardware real via kaiHEN/ounce-hbmenu.
body.en: Includes dedicated heroes_lore_2_switch2.nro build with bundled RomFS assets, verified on real Switch 2 hardware.

projects.releaseNotes: Adicionado heroes_lore_2_switch2.nro compilado com ounce-devkit para kaiHEN/ounce-hbmenu, mantendo builds para Android, Windows, Linux e Switch 1.

projects.title: Heroes Lore 3: Stigmata of Gaia

summary.pt: Recompilação nativa em C++ de Heroes Lore 3: Stigmata of Gaia para Windows, Linux, Android, Nintendo Switch 1 e Nintendo Switch 2, com auto-updater OTA integrado.
summary.en: Native C++ recompilation of Heroes Lore 3: Stigmata of Gaia for Windows, Linux, Android, Nintendo Switch 1, and Nintendo Switch 2, featuring built-in OTA auto-updates.

body.pt: Builds prontas para Switch 2 (heroes_lore_3_switch2.nro), Switch 1, Android, Windows e Linux.
body.en: Ready-to-run builds for Switch 2 (heroes_lore_3_switch2.nro), Switch 1, Android, Windows, and Linux.

projects.releaseNotes: Multiplatform release v1.0.8 with Switch 2 (heroes_lore_3_switch2.nro), Switch 1, Windows, Linux, and Android builds plus end-to-end OTA auto-update support.

projects.title: Heroes Lore Zero

summary.pt: Recompilação nativa multiplataforma de Heroes Lore Zero com suporte completo a Windows, Linux, Android, Nintendo Switch 1 e Nintendo Switch 2.
summary.en: Multiplatform native recompilation of Heroes Lore Zero with full support for Windows, Linux, Android, Nintendo Switch 1, and Nintendo Switch 2.

body.pt: Inclui build dedicada heroes_lore_zero_switch2.nro com recursos no RomFS, validada em hardware real via kaiHEN/ounce-hbmenu.
body.en: Includes dedicated heroes_lore_zero_switch2.nro build with bundled RomFS assets, verified on real Switch 2 hardware.

projects.releaseNotes: Adicionado heroes_lore_zero_switch2.nro compilado com ounce-devkit para kaiHEN/ounce-hbmenu (aprovado em console real), preservando as builds de Windows, Linux, Android e Switch 1.

projects.title: Heroes Lore 5: Covenant of Darkness

summary.pt: Recompilação nativa multiplataforma de Heroes Lore 5: Covenant of Darkness com PT-BR/EN, cloud save no Google Drive, atualizações pelo GitHub e otimizações ARM para Nintendo Switch 1.
summary.en: Multiplatform native recompilation of Heroes Lore 5: Covenant of Darkness featuring PT-BR/EN, Google Drive cloud saves, GitHub auto-updates, and ARM optimizations for Nintendo Switch 1.

body.pt: Compatível com Windows, Linux, Android e Nintendo Switch 1 (heroes_lore_5.nro); ainda não adaptado para Nintendo Switch 2.
body.en: Supports Windows, Linux, Android, and Nintendo Switch 1 (heroes_lore_5.nro); not yet adapted for Nintendo Switch 2.

projects.releaseNotes: Otimizações de desempenho no Nintendo Switch 1 (desfoque RGB565 nativo, 14 regiões ARM compiladas e redução de gravações no cartão SD), mantendo builds de Windows, Linux e Android.

summary.pt: Seu Pet. Sua Aventura. Sempre com Você! Experiência de pet virtual multiplataforma disponível no Google Play (Android & WearOS), Meta Horizon Store (Quest), Steam e Microsoft Store.
summary.en: Your Pet. Your Adventure. Always With You! Cross-platform virtual pet experience available on Google Play (Android & WearOS), Meta Horizon Store (Quest), Steam, and Microsoft Store.

body.pt: Lançado oficialmente na Google Play, Meta Horizon Store (Meta Quest), Steam e Microsoft Store.
body.en: Officially available on Google Play, Meta Horizon Store (Meta Quest), Steam, and Microsoft Store.

summary.pt: Media player multiplataforma em Flutter com suporte a Chromecast, aceleração por hardware, DNS switcher integrado (Google, Cloudflare, AdGuard), catálogo VOD e reprodução sincronizada.
summary.en: Cross-platform Flutter media player featuring Chromecast casting, hardware-accelerated decoding, built-in DNS switcher, rich VOD library, and synchronized playback.

summary.pt: Raio-x financeiro para compra de imóvel na planta: simula INCC mensal, evolução de obra, uso de FGTS, comparativo Caixa vs. outros bancos, gráficos de fluxo de caixa e relatórios em PDF.
summary.en: Financial planner for buying off-plan real estate in Brazil: simulates monthly INCC adjustments, construction-phase fees, FGTS usage, bank comparisons, cash-flow charts, and PDF reports.

summary.pt: Emulador de GBA, GBC e GB a 60 FPS construído com Flutter e ponte Dart FFI em C++, com busca dinâmica na biblioteca, feedback háptico e suporte a PT, EN e ES.
summary.en: 60 FPS GBA, GBC, and GB emulator built with Flutter and C++ Dart FFI bridges, featuring dynamic library search, haptic controls, and EN/PT/ES localization.

summary.pt: Gerenciador profissional de cifras e setlists em Flutter: transposição instantânea de tom, compartilhamento offline via QR Code animado, backup no Google Drive, importação PDF/DOCX e modo VR para Meta Quest.
summary.en: Professional guitar chord library and setlist manager built with Flutter: instant key transposition, offline animated QR sharing, Google Drive sync, PDF/DOCX import, and Meta Quest VR mode.

summary.pt: Biblioteca Flutter open-source (MIT) com mais de 235 ícones PNG exclusivos de alimentos e reconhecimento inteligente multilíngue de nomes e sinônimos de ingredientes.
summary.en: Open-source (MIT) Flutter package with 235+ custom food & ingredient PNG icons and smart multilingual name/synonym matching.
